segments.name: Touch screen business
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells medium- to large-sized projected capacitive touchscreens for financial, automotive, POS, gaming, lottery, medical and HMI customers.
segments.evidence: The Company determined that it operated in one operating segment of touch screen business.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue by selling various touchscreen products to customers in China and internationally.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues through sales of our various touchscreen products.

changes.text: In 2023, an independent third party acquired all shares of Sichuan Wetouch, whose business had been assumed by Sichuan Vtouch in 2021.
changes.evidence: On March 30, 2023, an independent third party acquired all the shares of Sichuan Wetouch for a nominal amount.
